title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Administration Fee per Approval
content:
## Clause

Each approval under Dangerous Goods Acceptance carries the category's administration fee at its full tariff amount. A fee charged with an earlier approval of the same acceptance remains on its account and does not lessen the fee that goes with a later approval.

## Tariff (USD per approval)

| Category | Administration fee |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 35.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 45.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 60.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 150.00 |

## Cases

- An AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives acceptance approved for the first time: 60.00.
- The same acceptance, reopened and approved again on a later date: a further 60.00, the earlier 60.00 staying on the account.
- An AHL DG Special Approval acceptance approved once: 150.00.

## Point of judgement

**Can the earlier administration fee be offset against the new one?** No; the earlier fee stands and the new approval carries its own fee in full.
